purpose: INERT TEMPLATE: compare instruction edits on sanitized receipt replays; no production role or live run

batch.selection: all approved sanitized completed receipts in the window, sorted by UTC timestamp then receipt ID; freeze once

evaluator.definition: Frozen receipt-specific assertions return one binary pass per replay; pass only when every required assertion passes. Every frozen receipt is evaluated exactly once. Errors invalidate the run.
evaluator.side_effects: none; replay sanitized snapshots with external integrations disabled

metric.name: receipt_pass_rate
metric.keep: valid and metric_after > metric_before; ties revert

budget.accounting: all mutation and evaluation model input, output, cache and reasoning tokens; shared cap across calls
budget.deadline: monotonic; includes mutation, dispatch, startup and evaluation

settings.seed_policy: fixed seed if supported; otherwise record unsupported and hold all other settings fixed

publication: Proposal only; dt:ship and standing merge_policy retain all gated effects
